title: Publish a custom message
description: A named interface makes a message contract explicit. Publish TargetInfo: visibility, position label and confidence.
steps: Inspect ros2 interface show ros2learn_interfaces/msg/TargetInfo.
Publish at least three valid messages on /target_info from Python. Confidence must be between 0 and 1.
Echo /target_info in a terminal. Change one field and explain why a Twist cannot be published on that same typed topic.
hints: Import TargetInfo from ros2learn_interfaces.msg.
The class is supplied directly in the browser; no interface generator is running.
TargetInfo(visible=True, position="LEFT", confidence=0.8)

content.title: Publish a custom message
content.description: A named interface makes a message contract explicit. Publish TargetInfo: visibility, position label and confidence.

Publish at least three valid messages on /target_info from C++. Confidence must be between 0 and 1.

hints: Include <ros2learn_interfaces/msg/target_info.hpp> and use ros2learn_interfaces::msg::TargetInfo.

Fill status.visible, status.position and status.confidence, then publish status on /target_info from a timer.
